newsitem.title: USA: Oncogene, Bayer to develop cancer tests.
newsitem.headline: Oncogene, Bayer to develop cancer tests.

text.p: Oncogene Science Inc and Bayer AG said on Thursday the two companies would jointly develop products to diagnose cancer.
Bayer will provide Oncogene Science with funding to continue research and development and cover other clinical development costs.
Oncogene's cancer diagnostics program has developed a series of antibodies and immunoassays for novel tumor markers designed to aid in the diagnosis and screening of cancer, the companies said.
Bayer offers cancer diagnostic tests through its Technicon Immuno 1R System, the companies said.
Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed, but the program was described by a spokesman as a "fully funded research and development program."
